test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**reflects**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate title of the given passage is **'Nutrition in children'.**
 
• The most appropriate word for the first blank is '**reflects**'.
 
• It means 'to show, express, or be a sign of something (किसी चीज को दिखाना, व्यक्त करना या संकेत होना)'.
 
 
• *Example: The statistics **reflect** a change in people's spending habits.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **think**: to have a particular idea or opinion about something/somebody; to believe. [किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के विषय में विशेष विचार या मत रखना; (कुछ) मानना]
 
• **group**: a number of people or things that are together in the same place or that are connected in some way. (समूह, दल, किसी प्रकार से परस्‍पर संबंधित या एक ही स्‍थान पर स्थित लोग या वस्‍तुएँ)
 
• **effort**: the physical or mental strength or energy that you need to do something; something that takes a lot of energy. [मानसिक या शारीरिक प्रयास (कोई काम करने के लिए अपेक्षित); ऐसा कार्य जिसमें बहुत शक्ति या प्रयास लगे]

 
 
 

**Correct Passage:__** *The most urgent areas of attention and immediate action are nutrition, health and education of children, whose well-being **reflects** the health of the society and caring outlook of the polity. Since the causes of malnutrition of children are many, like exploding population, (2)________ against the female child, weak and suffering mothers, the remedy calls for ‘care of the mother and care by mother’, (3)________, an effective control over population explosion. Ignorance on what food should be taken is another (4)________ factor that results in malnutrition among women and children. The implementation of various schemes to fight the (5)________ of malnutrition and undernourishment of children requires planning, co-ordination and monitoring by high-powered bodies right down to the village level.*

50:Teb6,

The correct answer is '**bias**'.
